name: ANU2023-Risk-of-Dragon
author: laserzone
description:
ANU COMP3540 Group 31 Risk of Dragon Game

Step into the scales of a mighty dragon and unleash chaos in a fantastical procedurally generated world filled with adventure and destruction. "Risk of Dragon" is an exhilarating Unity game where you assume the role of a powerful dragon with a mission: to collect portal shards, amass hoards of gold, and raze villages to the ground.
